Marta (docs): Quick idea — the error-ref page is getting long; customers still ask "which fallback happens first?" Can we add a tiny "mini-playbook" section that lists order + one-line why for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit hits?
Ibrahim (eng-runtime): Love that. A compact playbook (visual + table) would cut down on repeated questions. Runtime order we enforce: client retry -> middleware (trim/summarize) -> model variant fallback -> region failover. Streaming has slightly different semantics.
Kai (eng-ml): Add a short sentence about cache/kv compatibility when changing quantized variants — quantization sometimes changes key layout, so reuse attempts may fail and we should document expected cold-start latency.
Pri (devex): I can add two tiny SDK snippets: JS shows parsing `Retry-After` + decorrelated jitter, Python shows a minimal retry helper and a note about attaching `X-Request-ID` for tracing. Will add them as collapsible code blocks in the playbook.
Marta (docs): Great. I also want a 3-row decision table: trigger | recommended first action | next step. Eg: 429 | client retry+backoff | if persistent -> trim/model-down. timeout | cancel/trim/retry | if persists -> model-down. context-limit | trim/summarize | if persists -> model-down. Keep it short.
Ibrahim (eng-runtime): For streaming, add a bullet: "If streaming: prefer resumable sessions (resume tokens) rather than blind retries; otherwise stateful streams may duplicate output." Also I'll add queue-depth thresholds for the regional failover note.
Kai (eng-ml): I'll drop a tiny pseudo-code snippet for `trim_preserve_instructions()` that shows preserving system/instruction tokens while trimming context. Also include one-liner about testing quantized fallback locally (run small perf regression).
Marta (docs): Ownership: I'll open the PR with the mini-playbook + table + FAQ line "Should I always retry on 429?" — answer: start with backoff; escalate to trim/model-down if it persists; contact support if widespread. @Pri please add snippets to the PR, @Ibrahim please sanity-check the thresholds.
docs-bot: New PR opened by Marta: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6018 :robot_face:
Pri (devex): ETA for snippets: tomorrow AM. I'll keep examples very concise.
Ibrahim (eng-runtime): I'll review the PR and add a small infra test harness that simulates bursts of 429s so we can reference deterministic behavior in the playbook.
Kai (eng-ml): One more: include a short note about "what to expect" when model-down happens (possible output variance). That helps set user expectations.
Marta (docs): Perfect. Plan: merge when snippets + infra sanity check are in. Target: end of week. I'll add a changelog entry for release notes. Thanks!
